1: // Minimal endless runner with improved neon graphics
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 400;
10:   // audio context
11:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
12:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
13:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
14:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
15:     osc.type = 'sine';
16:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
17:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
18:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
19:     osc.start();
20:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
21:   }
22:   // neon gradient helper
23:   function neonGradient(color) {
24:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
25:     grad.addColorStop(0, `${color}AA`);
26:     grad.addColorStop(1, `${color}33`);
27:     return grad;
28:   }
29:   // background gradient for neon sky
30:   function skyGradient() {
31:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
32:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
33:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#005');
34:     return grad;
35:   }
36:   // starfield for background
37:   const stars = Array.from({length: 100}, () => ({
38:     x: Math.random() * width,
39:     y: Math.random() * height,
40:     size: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
41:     speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2
42:   }));
43:   // particle system for jumps
44:   const particles = [];
45: 
46:   // Game state
47:   let frame = 0;
48:   let score = 0;
49:   const speed = 4; // world scroll speed
50: 
51:   // Player definition
52:   const player = {
53:     w: 40,
54:     h: 60,
55:     x: 80,
56:     y: height - 60,
57:     vy: 0,
58:     gravity: 0.8,
59:     jumpStrength: -15,
60:     sliding: false,
61:     slideTimer: 0,
62:     update() {
63:       // apply gravity
64:       this.vy += this.gravity;
65:       this.y += this.vy;
66:       // floor collision
67:       const floor = this.sliding ? height - this.h / 2 : height - this.h;
68:       if (this.y > floor) {
69:         this.y = floor;
70:         this.vy = 0;
71:       }
72:       // slide duration
73:       if (this.sliding) {
74:         this.slideTimer--;
75:         if (this.slideTimer <= 0) this.sliding = false;
76:       }
77:     },
78:     draw() {
79:       ctx.fillStyle = neonGradient('#0ff');
80:       ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.w, this.sliding ? this.h / 2 : this.h);
81:     }
82:   };
83: 
84:   // Simple obstacle constructor
85:   function Obstacle(x, w, h) {
86:     this.x = x;
87:     this.w = w;
88:     this.h = h;
89:     this.y = height - h;
90:   }
91:   Obstacle.prototype.update = function() { this.x -= speed; };
92:   Obstacle.prototype.draw = function() {
93:     ctx.fillStyle = neonGradient('#f00');
94:     ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.w, this.h);
95:   };
96: 
97:   const obstacles = [];
98:   function spawnObstacle() {
99:     const w = 30 + Math.random() * 40;
100:     const h = 30 + Math.random() * 60;
101:     const x = width + w;
102:     obstacles.push(new Obstacle(x, w, h));
103:   }
104: 
105:   // Input handling
106:   document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
107:     // ensure audio context is running
108:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
109:     if (e.code === 'Space' && player.vy === 0) {
110:       player.vy = player.jumpStrength;
111:       // jump sound
112:       playTone(800, 0.12);
113:       // emit jump particles
114:       for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
115:         particles.push({
116:           x: player.x + player.w / 2,
117:           y: player.y + player.h / 2,
118:           vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2,
119:           vy: - (Math.random() * 3 + 2),
120:           size: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
121:           alpha: 1
122:         });
123:       }
124:     } else if (e.code === 'ArrowDown' && !player.sliding && player.vy === 0) {
125:       player.sliding = true;
126:       player.slideTimer = 30; // frames
127:       // slide sound
128:       playTone(400, 0.1);
129:     }
130:   });
131: 
132:   // Collision detection
133:   function checkCollision(ob) {
134:     const pw = player.w;
135:     const ph = player.sliding ? player.h / 2 : player.h;
136:     const px = player.x;
137:     const py = player.y;
138:     return !(px + pw < ob.x || px > ob.x + ob.w || py + ph < ob.y || py > ob.y + ob.h);
139:   }
140: 
141:   // Game loop
142:   function loop() {
143:     frame++;
144:     // clear with slight blur for neon effect
145:     ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
146:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
147: 
148:     // background starfield
149:     ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
150:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
151:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
152:     for (const s of stars) {
153:       s.y += s.speed;
154:       if (s.y > height) { s.y = 0; s.x = Math.random() * width; }
155:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.size, s.size);
156:     }
157: 
158:     // update and render particles (jump sparkle)
159:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
160:     for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
161:       const p = particles[i];
162:       p.x += p.vx;
163:       p.y += p.vy;
164:       p.vy += 0.05; // gravity
165:       p.alpha -= 0.02;
166:       if (p.alpha <= 0) { particles.splice(i, 1); continue; }
167:       ctx.fillStyle = neonGradient('#ff0');
168:       ctx.globalAlpha = p.alpha;
169:       ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.size, p.size);
170:     }
171:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1; // reset
172: 
173:     // update player
174:     player.update();
175:     player.draw();
176: 
177:     // spawn obstacles periodically
178:     if (frame % 90 === 0) spawnObstacle();
179: 
180:     // update & draw obstacles, remove off‑screen
181:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
182:       const ob = obstacles[i];
183:       ob.update();
184:       ob.draw();
185:       if (ob.x + ob.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
186:       else if (checkCollision(ob)) {
187:         // Game over – stop the loop
188:         ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
189:         ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
190:         ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 80, height / 2);
191:         return; // exit without requesting another frame
192:       }
193:     }
194: 
195:     // score display
196:     score = Math.floor(frame / 10);
197:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
198:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
199:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
200: 
201:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
202:   }
203: 
204:   // start
205:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
206: })();
